d:
'Voh Dekhnay Mein' from 'London Paris New York' is a cute bouncy number. Ali Zaffar's singing astounds with a wonderful smooth clear-cut voice in an attempt to bring in some kind of innocent naughtiness and enthusiasm to the number. This Bollywood romantic comedy film marks the writing and directing debut of Anu Menon with Ali Zafar and Aditi Rao Hydari in the lead roles.
Song Name - Voh Dekhnay Mein
Movie - London Paris New York
Singer - Ali Zafar
Composer - Ali Zafar
Lyricists - Ali Zafar
Music Label - Sony Music Entertainment India Pvt. Ltd.
